topic.title: Agricultural Buildings / Permitted Development / Prior Approval
topic.source_contract: agricultural unit and use, land area and tenancy, development class and limits, siting and design, protected-area restrictions, prior approval, planning permission, construction, agricultural use and compliance evidence

scope_guards: Agricultural ownership is not treated as agricultural use.
A farm over five hectares is not automatic approval for any building.
Permitted development rights are not treated as exemption from all conditions.
A prior approval submission is not treated as approval.
Prior approval is not treated as completed construction.
Completed construction is not treated as genuine agricultural use.
Temporary agricultural use is not treated as permanent compliance.
No score or promotion is written without exact class, approval, construction, use and compliance evidence.
